nodes.label: Style 5: VisualStack

nodes.label: Avalonia 11 XAML & Compiled Bindings Standards

nodes.label: NativeAOT & Self-Contained Publish Profiles

nodes.norm_label: keyboard navigation, focus rings & live regions

nodes.label: Frame-Budget Telemetry & GPU/Software Fallback Matrix

nodes.label: LyricDrawOperation (ICustomDrawOperation + ISkiaSharpApiLeaseFeature)

nodes.label: RenderResourceCache (Zero-Alloc Pool & Disposal)

nodes.label: EllipticalBulge SkSL Shader (Rendering Contract)
nodes.rationale: Uniforms: content, size, strength (negative=convex bulge), power; guards pow(0,p) NaN, clamps factor>=0.15, uses Decal tile mode.

nodes.label: 13-Tap DirectionalMotionBlur SkSL Shader (Rendering Contract)
nodes.rationale: Uniforms: content, velocity; 13 fixed taps [-0.5,+0.5], tent weight 1-|t|*1.2, fast-path bypass <0.5px, premul alpha + directional pad.

nodes.label: 6-Phase GSD Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Delivers 3-style MVP by Phase 3 and full 10-style parity by Phase 6.

nodes.label: OBS / Streamer Broadcast & Chroma-Key Capture Window
nodes.norm_label: obs / streamer broadcast & chroma-key capture window

nodes.label: LyricCanvasControl (RequestAnimationFrame Host)
nodes.rationale: Vsync RAF render loop with idle zero-burn stop gate, dt<=50ms clamp, IsHitTestVisible=false, and immutable FrameRenderPacket.

nodes.label: LyricPulse Platform Vision
nodes.rationale: Clean-room, free, open-source Windows desktop kinetic lyrics overlay with zero DRM or licensing lock.

nodes.label: Performance & Resource Budget
nodes.rationale: 60+ FPS overlay rendering, <3% idle CPU, <150 MB working set, zero UI-thread blocking.
